text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
âHer running form, seared into my 
eyelids.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Though she seemed gentle, even timid at 
times, on the turf, she underwent a 
complete transformation.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Those legs drove fiercely into the turf, 
hungering voraciously for the lead—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
L-Love-chan!? What happened to your leg... 
!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm fine. I just messed up my nail a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The wound hasn't closed up yet, so I'm 
just using crutches to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Her hoof...!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if it's a minor injury, if we 
damage a hoof, we'll...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, the Shuka Sho is coming up pretty 
soon, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then your next race is the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup. If it's November, we should have 
enough time to get you in shape!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said! Don't make that face. I'm 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry! If you've got a plan in 
sight, that's a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, it seems Love-chan is changing 
her target to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup."
choice_data_list:
I see... Well, I'm just glad it didn't 
turn into anything serious.

I see... But I'm glad it didn't turn into 
anything serious.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Gran-chan also had to give up on 
the Sprinters Stakes due to an injury...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to an injury, Gran Alegria had also 
sat out the Sprinters Stakes. I hear her 
return will be in the winter.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Being able to safely run in your 
target race is truly something you can 
never take for granted, is it...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why... I truly realized 
what an extraordinary feat those Triple 
Crown Umamusume have achieved."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To run in three races of completely 
different distances and win every single 
one...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the Classic Year. The royal 
road races of the Senior Year are the 
same...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Once again... I can only bow my head in 
reverence to our predecessors' great 
deeds.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Just being able to run as scheduled is 
wonderful...! As a fan, I want to give her 
a perfect attendance award."
choice_data_list:
By that logic, wouldn't Chrono be the 
same?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she manages to safely start in the 
Shuka Sho, it will mean she has run in 
every single race of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right... Though all I've done is 
give my all to the races right in front of 
me...
choice_data_list: We can add the Genesis Factor too!
We can add the Genesis Factor too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! Genesis Factor...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, running in 3 races is something to 
be proud of. It is worthy of the Genesis 
Factor...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The Genesis Factor within me is...—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Armed with that confidence, I will take on 
the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho— Loves-san isn't running in 
it...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The way you and I run, Chrono-san... It 
will be seen as the true strength of our 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I have to give it my all—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The Kurogane holly of Kyoto Racecourse, 
which has watched over the history of 
Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I, too... shall weave a history worthy of 
you.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You isn't here because of an 
injury, right? The lineup has changed 
quite a bit since the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
In that regard, Chrono Genesis is running 
in all 3 races. Amazing, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing their conversation, I pump my fist 
in quiet victory. I really wish she could 
have heard it too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're coming ou...... huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, isn't that Chrono Genesis!? She 
looks totally different from spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You seem more grounded, or like... more 
dignified? Your appearance hasn't changed, 
but is it your aura? Or something.

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume experience significant mental 
and physical growth during the summer of 
the Classic Class. Even if physical 
changes are subtle, increases in muscle 
mass and mental maturity become apparent.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"No... when I saw her at the racetrack, 
she was so frail, even staggering around, 
yet..."

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's completely transformed! The way 
she is now... she is undeniably strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I can't wait to see how she runs!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today... it looks like there are many 
people I'm running with for the first 
time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...I feel a little lonely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Neither Loves-san nor Gran-san are 
here..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is precisely why it's up to us 
today."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The evaluation of our generation... right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have each achieved our own 
results.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Today is the culmination of it all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I—intend to do the same. As one who 
carries the weight of this generation.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let's show them what we're capable of!
